dhauti
(‘process of cleansing’)
------------------------------------------
According to the Hindu scriptures, मोक्ष or spiritual emancipation is the goal of life. This can be attained through योग. योग may be practised in two stages: हठयोग and राजयोग. हठयोग prepares the body by cleansing it so that it is free from all ailments where as राजयोग cleanses the मिन्द् giving it the power to reveal or realise the Self within.
Dhauti is one of the well-known षट्कर्मस् or six purificatory processes in हठयोग and is of four kinds.
See ANTARDHAUTI for details. See also ṢAṬKARMAS.
